task: Extend B-be27 path-level scope protection to semantic hunks, diff packs, guarded session status, reviewer hash binding, and productized status output.
outcome: 用户运行 story_advance REVIEW/TEST/DONE 或 session_brief 时，会看到 Scope protection summary: path gate pass, semantic gate pass/warn/fail, guard mode active/watcher-fallback/inactive, review hash freshness, and concrete violating path+anchor+hunkDigest when a change is outside the planned story.
facts: B-be27 already added scope_contract_set/show/check/acknowledge and lifecycle path gate.
Current review evidence is already bound to reviewRunId/head/material hash, but not yet to scopeContractHash/diffPackHash/hunkDigest.
session_brief already renders story ownership and capsule-style summaries; guard status must extend this instead of replacing owner leases.
The story must keep old v1 scope contracts backward compatible.
Symbol extraction will start with pragmatic TS/JS heuristics and package/json key parsing; unsupported files must expose parseFallback.
Pre-tool support differs by provider; Koala will represent unsupported providers as watcher-fallback rather than claiming universal blocking.
constraints: Do not create a competing truth source for session ownership; guard session status is a projection only.
Old stories without v2 scope fields must not be hard-blocked.
Semantic parsing must fail safe: unknown file types fall back to hunk/file level, not silent pass.
Review hash binding can only become mandatory for stories with active scope protection.
